title: Task Vectors Can Be Linearly Decomposed into Interpretable and Controllable Components
abstract: arXiv:2610.41743v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Task Vectors (TVs) provide a compact way to steer large language models, but they are typically treated as atomized directions merely extracted from hidden states, leaving their internal functional structure poorly understood. Motivated by prior work that decomposes in-context learning into Task Recognition (TR) and Task Learning (TL), we ask whether a single TV can likewise be decomposed into functionally meaningful components. We formulate a TR/TL-based decomposition from candidate-label unembeddings, separating each TV into TR, TL, and residual components, and try to optimize the TR and TL coefficients using Bayesian optimization for more effective intervention. We evaluate this formulation across multiple model families, classification tasks, and both instruction- and demonstration-based TVs. translated_title: 任务向量可以被线性分解为可解释且可控的成分
translated_abstract: 任务向量提供了一种紧凑的方式来引导大型语言模型，但它们通常被视为仅从隐藏状态中提取的原子化方向，其内部功能结构尚不清楚。受先前将上下文学习分解为任务识别（TR）和任务学习（TL）的研究启发，我们探究单个任务向量是否同样可以分解为具有功能意义的成分。我们从候选标签的unembedding出发，提出了一种基于TR/TL的分解方法，将每个任务向量分离为TR、TL和残差三个成分，并尝试使用贝叶斯优化来优化TR和TL系数，以实现更有效的干预。我们在多个模型家族、多个分类任务以及基于指令和基于示例的任务向量上对这一方法进行了评估。在所有这些设置中，基于TR/TL的优化所确定的干预方向均优于原始任务向量。尽管基于优化……
tldr: 该论文提出将任务向量线性分解为任务识别（TR）、任务学习（TL）和残差三个可解释成分，并通过贝叶斯优化TR和TL系数，找到了比原始任务向量更有效的模型干预方向。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes linearly decomposing task vectors into interpretable Task Recognition (TR), Task Learning (TL), and residual components, and uses Bayesian optimization of the TR/TL coefficients to identify intervention directions that outperform the original task vectors.
